unit: WF4 Build Integrity Halt Notice count fallback without a guard count
description: When the arriving item carries no integrity_conflict_count (every containment shape except the Integrity Guard halt), the notice must fall back to integrity_detail.length exactly as before — the D-COUNT-01 fix must not change non-guard shapes.
why_it_exists: harness/FINDINGS.md section 1 close-out (D-COUNT-01, 2026-08-28). The Build Integrity Halt Notice fix reads integrity_conflict_count only when the guard supplies it. A Verify Selected Row halt (FINGERPRINT_CHANGED) carries integrity_detail but no guard count, so the heading and halt_conflict_count must fall back to detail.length (1), and halt_conflict_record_count must equal the same raw list length. This pins the fallback path so the fix cannot silently break the five other shapes that reach this node.

items.integrity_reason: The Action row for ACT-20260101-002-001 changed between the guard and the writer.

assertions: without a guard-supplied integrity_conflict_count, halt_conflict_count falls back to integrity_detail.length (1)
halt_conflict_record_count equals the raw detail length (1) — the fallback path is byte-for-byte what it was before the fix
the heading reads 'Conflicting records (1):' for the verify-shaped halt
halt_code and halt_stage classify the item as an approval-row verification halt
